mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_name AS name, m.menu_type, m.link_url, m.sort_order, m.depth, c.slug AS content_slug FROM tb_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_content c ON m.menu_type = 'CONTENT' AND c.content_id = m.link_target_id AND c.delete_yn = 'N' WHERE m.site_id = #{siteId} AND m.use_yn = 'Y' AND m.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY m.depth, m.sort_order, m.menu_id

SELECT m.menu_id, m.site_id, m.site_code, m.parent_menu_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.link_target_id, m.link_url, m.sort_order, m.depth, m.auth_required_yn, m.use_yn, p.menu_name AS parent_menu_name, c.title AS target_title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_menu ch WHERE ch.parent_menu_id = m.menu_id AND ch.delete_yn = 'N') AS child_count FROM tb_menu m LEFT JOIN tb_menu p ON p.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id LEFT JOIN tb_content c ON m.menu_type = 'CONTENT' AND c.content_id = m.link_target_id AND c.delete_yn = 'N' WHERE m.site_id = #{siteId} AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
AND m.menu_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordLike}, '%') ESCAPE '|'
ORDER BY m.depth, m.sort_order, m.menu_id

SELECT menu_id, site_id, site_code, parent_menu_id, menu_name, menu_type, link_target_id, link_url, sort_order, depth, auth_required_yn, use_yn FROM tb_menu WHERE menu_id = #{menuId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_menu WHERE parent_menu_id = #{menuId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_menu (menu_id, site_id, site_code, parent_menu_id, menu_name, menu_type, link_target_id, link_url, sort_order, depth, auth_required_yn, use_yn) VALUES (#{menuId}, #{siteId}, #{siteCode}, #{parentMenuId}, #{menuName}, #{menuType}, #{linkTargetId}, #{linkUrl}, #{sortOrder}, #{depth}, #{authRequiredYn}, #{useYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_menu SET menu_name = #{menuName}, menu_type = #{menuType}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, depth = #{depth}, auth_required_yn = #{authRequiredYn}, use_yn = #{useYn}, parent_menu_id = #{parentMenuId}, link_target_id = #{linkTargetId}, link_url = #{linkUrl}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
UPDATE tb_menu SET delete_yn = 'Y', use_yn = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
